mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (Viet Nam is not yet a party to the Hague Apostille Convention; documents must be notarized in origin then legalized by a Vietnamese diplomatic or consular mission, unless a bilateral legal assistance treaty provides otherwise)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Audited financial statements of each corporate shareholder for the last two fiscal years
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Independent auditor in the shareholder's home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (via the same notarization-translation-consular legalization chain)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board resolution / shareholders' resolution authorizing investment in Viet Nam, approval of VN_LLC charter, and appointment of legal representatives and authorized signatories
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate secretary or notary public in the corporate shareholder's home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (foreign corporate authority resolutions require notarization and consular legalization)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Passport copies of the foreign investor's legal representatives and ultimate beneficial owners

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based screening of all shareholders, UBOs, directors and legal representatives against the OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List, EU sanctions lists, Viet Nam's domestic criminal and administrative sanction records, and the State Bank of Viet Nam AML blacklist. PEP status flags enhanced due diligence, requiring documented origin of funds and senior management approval before any transaction is executed.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: National Enterprise Registration System / National Enterprise Registration Portal (Trang thông tin đăng ký doanh nghiệp) - https://dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Official Vietnamese trade names must be entered in Vietnamese using the Vietnamese alphabet, with letters A-Z and Arabic numerals. Each limited liability company name must contain the phrase 'Công ty TNHH' or a translated equivalent. An additional foreign-language name may be registered, but it must be submitted together with a Vietnamese name and must be displayed in smaller type so that the Vietnamese name remains dominant.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Names identical or confusingly similar to an already registered or protected enterprise name in Viet Nam
Names of State agencies, political organizations, people's armed forces or units thereof unless prior authorization is granted by the competent authority
Words that infringe on national sovereignty, history, traditions or cultural values
Terms such as 'bank', 'insurance', 'securities', 'investment fund' or other conditional business words requiring statutory ministerial license
Use of 'Viet Nam' in the company name without approval of the Ministry of Planning and Investment
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the enterprise name is rejected, the Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) issues a written notice of refusal. The applicant may (i) correct the proposed name and resubmit a new application, providing three alternative names in priority order; (ii) file a complaint with the Director of the DPI within 30 days of receiving the rejection; (iii) appeal to the Provincial People's Committee; and (iv) initiate proceedings before the administrative court under the Law on Administrative Procedures. A provisional name block is treated as being in effect only while an accepted registration application is pending or being corrected.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permissible as a standalone substitute for a statutory registered office. The foreign-invested LLC must have a permanent physical address in Viet Nam where the enterprise's name plate is displayed and where official notices can be served. For an ISIC 7020 cross-border tax consultancy, the registered address must be a licensed commercial premises; a co-working space may qualify only if it provides a dedicated room, lease contract, landlord consent and physical mail reception service.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low but material: approximately 20-25% probability of an unannounced inspection within the first 12 months of receiving the Investment Registration Certificate. The likelihood rises to 40% if the registered address is a co-working accommodation, or if the company reports unusually low revenue or rapid address changes; tax and investment regulators may carry out desk audits complemented by field verification.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14 of the National Assembly of the Socialist Republic of Viet Nam, effective 1 January 2021, Articles 22-39 on enterprise registration, Articles 74-110 on limited liability companies, Articles 27-31 on registration procedures; Law on Investment No. 61/2020/QH14, Articles 36-44 on investment registration for foreign-invested enterprises; Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP on enterprise registration; Decree No. 31/2021/ND-CP detailing the Law on Investment; Circular No. 01/2021/TT-KHDT prescribing enterprise registration forms; Law on Tax Administration No. 38/2019/QH14, Articles 98-103 for tax advisory practice licensing.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Business Registration Office under the provincial or municipal Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) of the jurisdiction where the registered office is located; Investment Registration Division of the same DPI for foreign-invested projects; National Business Registration Portal at https://dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn; National Public Service Portal for online submissions.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Enterprise Registration (Form A.I.1 - Giay de nghi dang ky doanh nghiep) accompanied by the Draft Company Charter (Form A.I.2), List of Members (Form A.I.3), and supporting dossiers, together with the Investment Registration Certificate previously issued to the foreign-invested project.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital applies to ISIC 7020 management consulting and transfer pricing advisory; charter capital is self-declared by members and stated in the Enterprise Registration Certificate. Each member must pay the full subscribed capital within 90 days from the date of issuance of the Enterprise Registration Certificate under Article 75 of Law on Enterprises 2020. No state-mandated escrow account exists at formation; the contribution must be deposited into a dedicated capital-contribution bank account held at a licensed commercial bank and reflected in the capital contribution ledger. Foreign corporate investors must evidence financial capacity through audited financial statements or a bank confirmation at the Investment Registration Certificate stage.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTION OF THE BOARD OF MEMBERS (SOLE MEMBER) OF [COMPANY NAME] LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY (FOREIGN INVESTED), adopted at the constitutive meeting held on [date] at the registered office [address]. WHEREAS: (a) the Company was incorporated under Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14 and holds Investment Registration Certificate No. [IRCNO] and Enterprise Registration Certificate No. [ERCNO]; (b) the Company Charter was approved by all members; (c) the Charter requires the constitutive governance organs and initial capital schedule to be adopted. NOW IT IS RESOLVED: 1. CAPITAL SUBSCRIPTION: the charter capital of the Company is fixed at VND [amount] subscribed by the members in the proportions stated in the List of Members and shall be fully paid into the Company capital-contribution bank account within 90 days from the Enterprise Registration Certificate date. 2. REGISTERED OFFICE: the registered office is adopted at [full address], Viet Nam, being the official address for statutory correspondence and regulatory filings; the legal representative shall file the office lease and landlord documentation with the Business Registration Office. 3. OFFICER APPOINTMENTS: (a) [name] is elected Chairman of the Board of Members; (b) [name] is appointed General Director and Chief Executive Officer with full ordinary management powers; (c) [name] is appointed Legal Representative of the Company authorized to execute contracts, regulatory filings, banking documents, and judicial correspondence; (d) [name] is appointed Chief Accountant and Tax Compliance Officer. 4. GOVERNANCE AND LICENSING: the Board approves the internal governance manual, AML risk assessment policy, corporate seal protocol, tax registration confirmation, and the application for tax advisory practice licensing under Law on Tax Administration No. 38/2019/QH14. 5. BANKING: the Legal Representative is authorized to open corporate bank accounts, give evidence of capital contributions, and record any member percentage changes with the Business Registration Office. 6. EFFECT: this Resolution is effective as of adoption, has been entered in the corporate resolution register, and certified copies shall be notarized for use in regulatory and banking filings. Adopted unanimously by all members.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Application for Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) for the Foreign-Invested LLC
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) of the province/city of the proposed registered office - Investment Registration Division; electronic filing through the National Public Service Portal or the DPI one-stop-shop window.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a complete investment registration dossier for a new foreign-invested project under Law on Investment No. 61/2020/QH14, Articles 36-39. The project covering international tax structuring and transfer pricing advisory under ISIC 7020 is not on the list of conditional market-access sectors, so the standard 15-working-day procedure applies. The dossier must describe the consulting scope, lawful office location evidenced by a lease agreement or a memorandum of commitment for the address, identity documents of individual investors or parent entity corporate documents, and financial capacity proof. The DPI issues the IRC or requests clarification; after issuance, proceed to enterprise registration.
required_dossiers: Application Form A.H1 for investment project registration
Notarized copy of the parent company incorporation certificate (if corporate investor)
Audited financial statements or bank financial capacity confirmation of the foreign investor
Copies of passport or identity documents of individual investors and legal representative
Office premise documentation: lease agreement or locality commitment for the registered address
Charter of the proposed LLC or investment cooperation agreement if multiple investors
Power of attorney for the project filing agent (if applicable)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the DPI issues a written request for clarification or supplementary information, the applicant must cure within 10 working days. If the application is denied, the investor may file a written objection to the DPI, then appeal to the provincial People's Committee under Article 145 of the Law on Investment, or commence administrative court proceedings within 30 days of receipt of the refusal decision.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of the Enterprise Registration Application and Issuance of the Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Business Registration Office under the provincial/municipal Department of Planning and Investment; National Business Registration Portal at https://dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the IRC is granted, prepare and submit online the Application for Enterprise Registration (Form A.I.1) with the Draft Company Charter (Form A.I.2), List of Members (Form A.I.3), notarized legal documentation of members, registered office lease, and legal representative appointment forms. The application must be signed with a registered digital certificate if submitted electronically. The Business Registration Office issues the ERC within 3 working days for a valid and complete dossier. The ERC simultaneously activates the enterprise tax code and entry into the National Business Registration Database.
required_dossiers: Application for Enterprise Registration (Form A.I.1)
Draft Company Charter (Form A.I.2)
List of Members (Form A.I.3)
Investment Registration Certificate of the project
Notarized copies of legal entity registration or passport of each member
Legal representative appointment documentation (Form A.I.4 or A.I.5)
Registered office lease agreement with landlord title evidence
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the dossier is invalid or incomplete, the DPI issues a written correction request specifying defects, and the applicant has up to 15 working days to cure. If the request is rejected, the applicant is entitled to a written refusal with legal grounds under Article 28 of Law on Enterprises 2020; remedies include an administrative appeal to the provincial People's Committee or the Ministry of Planning and Investment, followed by administrative court proceedings.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Public Announcement of Business Registration Content
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Business Registration Portal (publication service administered by the Department of Planning and Investment).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within 30 days after issuance of the Enterprise Registration Certificate, the company must file a Notice of Public Announcement (Form II-4) with the National Business Registration Portal. The publication discloses the enterprise name, enterprise code, legal form, registered office, principal business line ISIC 7020, charter capital, members, and legal representative. The statutory publication fee is VND 100,000 but is exempt when submitted online; the electronic announcement is posted on the national database.
required_dossiers: Notice of Public Announcement (Form II-4)
Copy of Enterprise Registration Certificate
Electronic confirmation of online submission fee exemption or payment receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Late publication or non-publication exposes the company to administrative fines of VND 1,000,000 to 3,000,000 under Decree 50/2016/ND-CP, as amended. The cure is immediate electronic filing of the announcement and payment of the assessed penalty; the DPI stamps the late-filed notice with the actual submission date.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Seal Creation and Seal Sample Notification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Business Registration Office of the Department of Planning and Investment; licensed seal engraving establishments supervised by the Ministry of Public Security.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Following ERC issuance, the company commissions the fabrication of the corporate seal from a licensed engraving facility. The Board adopts a seal release decision specifying custody and usage control. Within 5 working days after the seal is first used, the company must notify the seal sample through the National Business Registration Portal under Articles 43-44 of Law on Enterprises 2020 and Decree 01/2021/ND-CP; the DPI updates the National Business Registration Database. The register seal is not a condition for contract validity, but statutory documents, contracts, and tax declarations must bear the registered seal where the Charter so requires.
required_dossiers: Seal sample notification (Form I.6)
Board decision authorizing seal creation and release
Specimen seal impression affixed to the notification
Copy of Enterprise Registration Certificate and Investment Registration Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the seal sample notification is rejected or queried, the company must correct the specimen and resubmit within the DPI-prescribed cure period. Use of an unregistered seal is a statutory infringement subject to fines under Decree 50/2016/ND-CP; loss of seal must be immediately published on the national portal and a replacement notification filed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Constitutive Governance Meeting and Adoption of the First Board Resolution
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Internal corporate governance body of the company (Sole Member or Board of Members); evidence subsequently retained in the corporate resolution register and notified to the Business Registration Office where officer changes occur.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within 15 days of ERC issuance, convene the constitutive meeting to adopt the pro-forma First Board Resolution, elect the Chairman of the Board of Members, appoint the General Director/CEO, designate the Legal Representative with specimen signature, appoint the Chief Accountant, adopt the registered office, approve the charter capital payment schedule, and authorize the opening of banking accounts. Minutes of the meeting and each appointment decision must be recorded in the corporate administration book. The Legal Representative must be notified in the national register; any subsequent change of legal representative is a mandatory change registration within 10 days.
required_dossiers: First Board Resolution as provided in the incorporation legal framework
Minutes of the constitutive meeting signed by members
Appointment decisions for Chairman, General Director, and Legal Representative
Written acceptance of office signed by each appointee
Internal governance and AML risk control policy endorsement
Chief Accountant eligibility confirmation documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Defects in minutes or appointments are curable by an extraordinary members' meeting adopting a restating resolution rectifying the records. Failure to notify a change of legal representative to the DPI within 10 days triggers administrative fines of up to VND 15,000,000 under Decree 50/2016/ND-CP; the cure is re-filing the change amendment on the National Business Registration Portal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening of Corporate Bank Account, Payment of Charter Capital, and Tax Registration Confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed commercial banks in Viet Nam supervised by the State Bank of Viet Nam; General Department of Taxation for tax code activation; Business Registration Office for capital structure amendments.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a dedicated capital-contribution bank account in the name of the LLC at a licensed commercial bank and procure full payment of the subscribed charter capital by members within 90 days of the ERC date under Article 75 of Law on Enterprises 2020. Execute a capital contribution record and deposit it in the company records; if the capital contribution schedule is later adjusted, register the corresponding change in charter capital and member percentages with the Business Registration Office within 10 days. The tax code is automatically activated via the ERC; if required, complete the supplementary tax registration dossier online at the General Department of Taxation portal confirming VAT, CIT, and labor obligations.
required_dossiers: Enterprise Registration Certificate and Investment Registration Certificate
Corporate bank account application and anti-money-laundering KYC forms
First Board Resolution authorizing account opening and signatory list
Capital contribution payment evidence and capital contribution record
Charter capital change registration form if the schedule is modified
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank refuses account opening on KYC grounds, the company must produce refreshed corporate authorization records or select another licensed bank. If a member fails to pay the subscribed capital by the 90th day, the remaining members may vote to revoke the defaulting member's membership rights under Article 75(2), and the company must register the amended capital structure; late payment interest and statutory penalties apply.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Conditional Business License Application for Tax Advisory Practice
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry of Finance - General Department of Taxation (Tax Practitioner Administration Division); submission through the Viet Nam Tax Portal or the National Public Service Portal.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Because the company provides international tax structuring and transfer pricing advisory services under ISIC 7020, it must satisfy the conditional business regime for tax administration services under Law on Tax Administration No. 38/2019/QH14, Articles 98-103, and Decree No. 126/2020/ND-CP. At least one tax practitioner of the company must hold a valid tax practice certificate, and the company must submit a registration dossier for the tax service organization. The General Department of Taxation reviews the dossier and issues the operating certificate within a total cure-and-decision period of 30 working days. Subject to the certificate, the company may contractually provide tax procedure agency and transfer pricing advisory; otherwise it must limit operations to general management consulting outside reserved tax-procedure activities.
required_dossiers: Registration form for tax service organization under MOF regulations
Valid tax practice certificates of the principal tax practitioners
Copy of Enterprise Registration Certificate and Investment Registration Certificate
List of tax service staff with assigned roles
Main office lease contract and Charter
Internal quality control and tax professional confidentiality undertaking
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the General Department of Taxation requests amendment, the company must resubmit within the prescribed cure period, ordinarily not exceeding 30 days; an explicit denial may be appealed to the Minister of Finance and subsequently to the administrative court. As a fallback, the company may operate only in general consulting and tax-educational services outside reserved tax procedure agency until the practitioners obtain the required certificates.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Finance - General Department of Taxation (Tax Practitioner Administration Division) for the tax advisory practice license; coordination with the provincial Department of Planning and Investment for conditional business registration; Department of Construction and Fire and Rescue Police for physical premises clearance.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Certificate of Registration for Tax Service Organization and Tax Practice Certificates for Individual Tax Practitioners (Giay chung nhan dang ky to chuc cung cap dich vu ve thue; Chung chi hanh nghe dich vu lam thu tuc ve thue) issued under Law on Tax Administration No. 38/2019/QH14, Articles 98-103, and Decree No. 126/2020/ND-CP.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Viet Nam Environmental Administration (VEA) under the Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MONRE); provincial Department of Natural Resources and Environment (DONRE) for environment registration-level clearance.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category III - Environmental Registration (Dang ky moi truong) under Law on Environmental Protection No. 72/2020/QH14 and Decree No. 08/2022/ND-CP; a full Environmental Impact Assessment report is not required because the activity is office-based professional consulting with no manufacturing, no industrial process emissions, and no wastewater generation beyond domestic sanitary discharge.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Domestic wastewater discharge must comply with QCVN 14:2008/BTNMT, with BOD5 not exceeding 30 mg/L and coliform not exceeding 3,000 MPN/100mL, before transfer to the municipal collection system; solid and electronic waste must be handed to licensed recycling and collection service providers under Decree 08/2022/ND-CP; point-source VOC and industrial dust emissions do not arise from office operations; HVAC refrigerants must be ODS-free; ambient noise at the premises boundary must not exceed 70 dBA daytime and 55 dBA night-time per QCVN 26:2010/BTNMT; any hazardous waste generated in minute office quantities must be minimized, identified, and transferred under electronic manifest to licensed treatment facilities within 60 days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Prevention and Fighting (PCCC) design appraisal and acceptance certification by the provincial Fire and Rescue Police under Law on Fire Prevention and Fighting No. 27/2001/QH10 as amended and Decree No. 136/2020/ND-CP; the office must pass post-completion inspection including accessible exits, fire extinguishers, emergency lighting, and internal water supply. Structural load and occupancy clearance from the Department of Construction is required where the building use is changed or where renovation affects load-bearing elements. Workplace occupational safety and health clearance is required under Law on Occupational Safety and Health No. 84/2015/QH14, including electrical safety verification, first-aid provisions, annual fire drills, health check arrangements for employees, and insurance coverage for occupational accidents and diseases.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: General Department of Taxation (Tổng cục Thuế) of the Ministry of Finance of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam; official e-tax and e-invoice portals: https://thuedientu.gdt.gov.vn and https://hoadondientu.gdt.gov.vn; national business registration portal: https://dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn; local tax administration is carried out by provincial/sub-provincial Tax Departments (Cục Thuế) where the LLC has its head office.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign investor establishing a Vietnamese limited liability company must: (1) obtain an Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) from the competent Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) where foreign ownership triggers the investment registration procedure under the Law on Investment 2020; (2) file the Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC) application through DangKyKinhDoanh.Gov.Vn; (3) upon issuance of the ERC, the General Department of Taxation automatically issues a 13-digit enterprise tax identification number (MST) that is simultaneously the VAT identification number, with no separate TIN application required; (4) activate the enterprise's e-tax account at ThueDienTu.Gdt.Gov.Vn, appoint a legal representative and registered digital signature, and register for electronic tax declaration and payment; (5) register for e-invoicing on HoaDonDienTu.Gdt.Gov.Vn; and (6) file the CIT registration and, where the entity is a constituent entity of an MNE group, submit the OECD Pillar Two top-up tax registration particulars under Resolution 107/2023/QH15. A foreign contractor without a permanent establishment in Vietnam does not procure a Vietnamese TIN; instead the Vietnamese counterparty withholds Foreign Contractor Tax (FCT) under Circular 103/2014/TT-BTC.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation: A Vietnamese LLC is a separate resident enterprise subject to corporate income tax at 20% on worldwide income. Vietnam does not recognize pass-through or transparent taxation for LLCs; the LLC itself is the taxpayer, with distributions to foreign shareholders subject to a separate 0% domestic CIT exemption for qualifying dividends and potential Foreign Contractor Tax on other remittances.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Vietnam has no U.S.-style check-the-box or general hybrid-mismatch election. Available statutory choices include: (i) an election for qualifying micro and small enterprises to apply a simplified presumptive CIT regime on a percentage of revenue under Decree 97/2023/ND-CP and related guidance; (ii) for non-resident foreign contractors only, an election between the Direct Method and the Deduction Method under Circular 103/2014/TT-BTC; (iii) an election to apply for an Advance Pricing Arrangement (APA) under the transfer pricing rules of Decree 132/2020/ND-CP; and (iv) for in-scope MNE groups, the election and application of the Vietnamese QDMTT (Qualified Domestic Minimum Top-up Tax) and IIR top-up tax regime under Resolution 107/2023/QH15 and Decree 139/2024/ND-CP. Vietnam also applies hybrid-mismatch-type defenses through the 30% EBITDA interest deduction cap, controlled-transaction substance requirements, and specific non-deductibility rules for intra-group payments lacking commercial substance.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Thuế Giá Trị Gia Tăng / Value Added Tax)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No VAT registration threshold applies to a resident LLC: VAT registration is mandatory for every enterprise upon issuance of the Enterprise Registration Certificate, irrespective of revenue levels. For an individual or household business, the VAT Law sets a de minimis annual revenue threshold of VND 100,000,000, below which VAT is not imposed. A foreign contractor without a permanent establishment in Vietnam does not register for VAT; instead, VAT and CIT are withheld under the Foreign Contractor Tax mechanism, generally with no input VAT refund available under the Direct Method.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory electronic invoicing applies under Decree 123/2020/ND-CP and Circular 78/2021/TT-BTC: every output VAT invoice must be created as an XML-format e-invoice through the GDT portal or an authorized e-invoice service provider, bear a compliant digital signature and QR code, and be transmitted to HoaDonDienTu.Gdt.Gov.Vn. Where the tax authority invoice code applies, the GDT performs real-time clearance by issuing a 10-digit or 12-digit verification code before the invoice becomes legally effective for tax purposes; otherwise, e-invoice data must be transmitted no later than the end of the next working day. Export goods are additionally cleared electronically through the VNACCS/VCIS customs system; service exports are substantiated through the 0% e-invoice and the statutory offshore-service documentation package.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exported goods and services qualify for the 0% VAT rate under Article 9 of Decree 219/2013/ND-CP and Circular 219/2013/TT-BTC when the following criteria are satisfied: (i) goods are physically exported through customs and covered by an electronic customs export declaration, or services are supplied to a foreign customer and consumed entirely outside Vietnam; (ii) the customer is a non-resident organization or individual with no Vietnamese business establishment; (iii) for consultancy services (including international tax structuring and transfer pricing advisory), the services must be produced, delivered, and used abroad, and the advisory deliverable must not be exploited in Vietnam by the Vietnamese LLC or any Vietnamese party; (iv) there is a valid international service agreement between the Vietnamese LLC and the offshore client; (v) payment is received in foreign currency through international banking channels and duly repatriated to Vietnam; and (vi) the exported service does not simultaneously benefit a Vietnamese resident establishment. A Vietnamese LLC providing cross-border advisory services to its offshore parent or a third-party foreign client may apply the 0% rate only where the substance of the service is demonstrably exported, not consumed in Vietnam.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (for goods) cleared electronically through the VNACCS/VCIS customs system
Bill of Lading / Air Waybill (for goods; not applicable to pure service exports)
Inward Remittance Certificate or foreign-currency deposit receipt issued by a licensed Vietnamese bank confirming receipt of export proceeds in Vietnam
International service or advisory agreement with the foreign customer, governing the cross-border supply of tax structuring and transfer pricing advisory services
0% VAT e-invoice carrying the GDT-compliant XML/QR code
Service completion certificate, final advisory report, and deliverables proving offshore consumption of the consultancy services
Certificate of corporate residency or other evidence establishing the foreign customer's non-Vietnamese status
Extract from the Vietnamese LLC's foreign-currency bank account showing receipt and date of export proceeds for the 180-day repatriation verification
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Export zero-rating claims are subject to strict audit scrutiny. Absent compliant documentation or when payment is not received and repatriated within the statutory 180-day deadline, the tax authority may re-assess output VAT at 10%, disallow any input VAT refund claimed, clawback refunded amounts, and apply late-payment interest at 0.03% per day. Administrative penalties under Decree 125/2020/ND-CP range from fines equal to 20% of under-declared tax to up to 3 times the under-declared or evaded tax amount for deliberate fraud. Forgery of export invoices, customs declarations, international contract signatures, or bank remittance proofs triggers criminal liability under the Penal Code 2015 (Articles 200 and 341), with imprisonment up to 7 years for tax evasion involving, or causing tax loss of, VND 100,000,000 or more; all false refunds must be restored and the 10-year statutory record-keeping period remains subject to retrospective clawback.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: State Bank of Vietnam (Ngân hàng Nhà nước Việt Nam) — Foreign Exchange Control Department, administering the Ordinance on Foreign Exchange 2005, Decree 70/2014/ND-CP (as amended by Decree 100/2023/ND-CP), and Directive 04/2021/CT-NHNN on foreign exchange management.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vietnamese Dong (VND) is a managed-floating, not fully convertible currency. Current-account transactions (trade in goods and services, dividends, interest, royalties, consultancy fees) are freely transferable subject to underlying documentation, tax clearance, and anti-money-laundering verification. Capital-account transactions (FDI equity injections, intercompany loans, portfolio investments) are restricted and require prior registration through the Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA) at an authorized commercial bank, the Investment Registration Certificate (IRC), and SBV approval for cross-border borrowings. Profit remittance is permitted annually only after publication of audited financial statements, full tax finalization, and satisfaction of the foreign-invested enterprise's ongoing disclosure obligations. VND has no meaningful offshore NDF or spot market, so cross-border settlement is effectively USD/EUR-denominated through licensed onshore banks.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Export proceeds must be repatriated into Vietnam within 180 days from the date of customs clearance. The mandatory foreign-currency surrender ratio (historically 80% under Circular 15/2015/TT-NHNN) was eliminated effective 2019 by Circular 06/2019/TT-NHNN; exporters may retain foreign currency in accounts at authorized commercial banks and freely convert subject to SBV quotations. The SBV retains authority to reintroduce mandatory surrender in balance-of-payments emergency conditions under the Ordinance on Foreign Exchange. For a cross-border tax-consulting entity, service receivables are classified as current-account earnings and must be credited to a foreign-currency or VND transaction account within the same 180-day timeline, with supporting export/export-of-services contracts.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account and Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA) Hosting

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Joint Stock Commercial Bank for Investment and Development of Vietnam (BIDV)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low for onshore VND/domestic clearing; Medium for offshore receivable collection only. Offshore digital EMIs (e.g., Wise, Revolut Business, Payoneer) do not hold a Vietnamese payment intermediary license under Decree 101/2012/ND-CP, cannot open VND settlement accounts, cannot host DICA structures, and cannot intermediate FDI capital contributions or statutory profit remittances. Their permissible use is limited to collection of consultancy fees in USD/EUR abroad; funds must be repatriated through an authorized onshore commercial bank with a compliant FX purpose code. They are therefore not viable as a primary treasury or clearing rail but may serve as a secondary receivable-assembly layer.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Mandatory physical appearance of at least one legal representative (Chairman, General Director, or authorized signatory with statutory delegation) at the bank branch is the prevailing market practice for opening onshore accounts for a foreign-invested LLC. Remote opening is not generally permitted for primary account holders. A notarized power of attorney (Hague Apostille where applicable) authorizing a resident director, chief accountant, or local compliance officer to complete the in-person interview is accepted by most tier-1 banks, provided the remaining directors undergo video/telephonic identity verification and the bank's internal risk committee approves the exception. Passport, valid residence permit (if resident), ERC, IRC, and evidence of registered business address are mandatory at the onboarding meeting.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO) opacity created by a tiered offshore SPV holding structure.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized certificate of incorporation and constitutional documents for each entity in the ownership chain; completed UBO declaration form in compliance with Decree 76/2023/ND-CP; passport copies of all natural persons holding 10% or more (or exercising de facto control); consolidated corporate-organization chart; bank references from each upstream holding-company bank.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Politically Exposed Person (PEP) status of a shareholder or director.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed PEP and source-of-wealth declarations; independent PEP screening report from a reputable due-diligence database; audited financial statements and tax returns evidencing legitimate income; engagement letters and pipeline contracts demonstrating genuine tax-structuring advisory revenue.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Charter capital funding routed from related offshore entities lacking commercial substance.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed share subscription agreement with a clear disbursement schedule; audited financial statements of the capital contributor; bank confirmation and statements of the remitting account; corporate-registry extract of the contributor; written board resolution explaining the economic purpose of the Vietnam investment.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Statutory licensing gap for cross-border tax advisory services (ISIC 7020).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Valid Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) and Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC) reflecting ISIC 7020; tax agent certificate under Law on Tax Administration 38/2019/QH14 Article 102 where the service constitutes tax agency work; professional indemnity insurance; sample engagement letters showing non-regulated consultancy scope.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk jurisdiction funding flows or unusual FX conversion patterns.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Commercial rationale memorandum explaining cross-border fee economics; substance documentation (physical office lease, payroll records, board minutes); OFAC/EU/UN sanctions-list screening results; independent third-party AML review report; transaction-level audit trail of source and intended use of funds.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant routing requires (1) issuance of the IRC/ERC with an approved charter-capital schedule; (2) opening of the Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA) at an authorized commercial bank within 30 days of IRC issuance; (3) remittance of charter capital via SWIFT MT103 with the standardized BPM6/ITRS FDI-equity purpose code (equity investment in direct-investment enterprises) and the IRC number quoted in the remittance field; (4) bank-side cross-border KYC and source-of-funds verification; (5) parking of funds in the DICA, with conversion to VND or retention in USD based on lawful operational needs; (6) matching of each withdrawal or conversion against the capital-contribution schedule registered with the DICA and the provincial Department of Planning and Investment; and (7) annual reconciliation with the State Bank of Vietnam's Foreign Exchange Control Department through the DICA reporting form.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Clearing rails for outbound settlements: (i) SWIFT MT103 for direct service payments, subcontractor fees, and disbursements above the USD 5,000 declaration threshold; (ii) irrevocable Commercial Documentary Letters of Credit (at sight or usance) for procurement requiring transport or delivery evidence; (iii) SWIFT MT202 for interbank positioning of funds between the Vietnam treasury account and upstream correspondent banks; and (iv) domestic non-cash clearing (ACH-style interbank electronic payments) for VND-denominated operational expenses. All outbound FX payments require the underlying commercial contract, invoice, tax invoice, customs declaration (for goods), and, for dividend remittances, audited financial statements plus tax finalization (Form 02/ĐNTXU). Decree 23/2024/ND-CP prohibits single VND cash payments above VND 100 million, so all clearing must be non-cash.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: OTC FX forward contracts (VND vs USD/EUR) with maturity up to 365 days under Decree 92/2018/ND-CP
FX swaps (spot component plus forward re-exchange) transacted with SBV-licensed authorized commercial banks
Foreign currency options (physically settled, underlying must be current-account trade-flow exposure)
Cross-currency interest-rate swaps of floating/exchange VND and USD cash flows, available only from SBV-authorized derivative dealers
Note: Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on VND are not permitted onshore; any offshore NDF hedging is outside the legal perimeter and cannot be booked through a Vietnam-licensed entity.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Business License Fee declaration and payment (Lệ phí môn bài)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Tax Department of the enterprise's province/city (under the General Department of Taxation)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 30 January each year; newly established FIEs are exempt in the first calendar year and begin remitting from the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-payment interest at 0.03% per day; administrative penalties under Decree 125/2020/ND-CP on the unpaid balance; persistent non-payment triggers tax enforcement and seizure proceedings

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Investment Activity Report (Báo cáo hoạt động đầu tư)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) or industrial/EPZ authority managing the investment project
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after the fiscal year-end (by 31 January for a calendar-year enterprise)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines under Decree 50/2016/ND-CP (as amended by Decree 122/2021/ND-CP) up to VND 20 million; repeated omissions expose the investor to suspension or termination of the Investment Registration Certificate under Law on Investment 2020

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Enterprise Operation Report (Báo cáo tình hình hoạt động của doanh nghiệp)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Business Registration Office of the Department of Planning and Investment where the enterprise is headquartered
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days of each anniversary of the Enterprise Registration Certificate date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fine of VND 10–20 million under Decree 122/2021/ND-CP; two consecutive years of non-filing with no activity at the registered address may trigger administrative dissolution and strike-off of the enterprise registration

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax finalization return (Tờ khai quyết toán thuế TNDN)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 90th day after the fiscal year-end (31 March for calendar-year taxpayers)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing fines from warning up to VND 25 million (Decree 125/2020/ND-CP) plus 0.03%/day late-payment interest; under-declaration penalty of 20% of the underpaid tax and potential fraud/evasion penalties up to 100%

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Personal Income Tax finalization return for employee payroll (Tờ khai quyết toán thuế TNCN)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 90th day after the fiscal year-end (31 March for calendar-year taxpayers)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing fines up to VND 25 million and 0.03%/day late-payment interest; withholding-agent liability for underwithheld PIT

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual audited statutory financial statements (Báo cáo tài chính năm đã kiểm toán)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial/City Tax Authority and General Statistics Office (parallel submission)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days after the fiscal year-end (31 March for calendar-year taxpayers); audited version attached for foreign-invested enterprises
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines under Decree 125/2020/ND-CP for late/non-submission up to VND 20 million; failure to undergo mandated independent audit is separately sanctioned under Decree 41/2018/ND-CP with fines up to VND 50 million

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 20% standard CIT rate on net taxable income (Law on Corporate Income Tax, Article 10; applies from 1 January 2016).
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Viet Nam grants incentives primarily by geographic zone and sector. Projects granting new investments in qualifying sectors or locations can receive a 10% rate for up to 15 years (with a 4-year full tax holiday and 9-year 50% reduction), or a 17% rate for up to 10 years (2-year holiday, 4-year 50% reduction). A 10% rate applies for newly established high-tech enterprise, software or IT service projects. Income from the LLC’s advisory activity that does not qualify for zone/sector incentives remains taxed at the 20% headline rate; no blanket holding-company or headquarters exemptions apply in Viet Nam.
